topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon a photograph today, of a back, a canvas of skin vividly adorned with my art. It was like seeing a part of my soul etched elsewhere, a piece of my vision now a permanent part of someone’s story. At first, there was shock, a jolt of surprise. But then, a strange, warm pull. This stranger had not just admired my work; they had chosen to carry it with them, to wear it as a symbol of something deeply personal. It's strange, the paths art takes, the lives it touches. I can only hope that my creation brings them as much joy as its journey has brought me.
